title: School Admin Permissions & SDO Direct Provisioning
message: GabAI v0.3.8 fixes Firestore permissions for School Admin onboarding and adds direct provisioning in the Admin Portal!
changelog:
• School Admin Claim Fix: Eliminates race conditions in onAuthStateChanged and adds graceful fallback for unauthenticated invite reads
• SDO Direct Admin Provisioning: Division Super Admins can now directly create and authorize School Administrators for any campus
• Comprehensive Firestore Security Rules: Added airtight firestore.rules covering school_admin_invites, users, and schools
• Faculty Registry Role Management: Super Admins can now promote and assign educators to School Administrator roles
